title: Pareto DNN Verification: Fast for Most Queries
abstract: arXiv:2512.20755v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Formal verification of deep neural networks (DNNs) faces a fundamental scalability challenge: verifying robustness is NP-hard and state-of-the-art tools often time out on modern architectures. We propose PAreto VErification, or PAVE: by augmenting DNNs with early exits (EEs) and verifying exit-by-exit, we solve a large fraction of robustness queries---roughly 80% in our evaluation---in a small fraction of the time required for direct verification. The key insight is that many inputs in a robustness neighborhood exit at an early layer. Verifying this early-exit behavior is often a tractable problem,allowing verification to terminate long before the full network is analyzed. EEs can be added without modifying the base network, and incur at most a 0.3% accuracy change across our tested architectures. We formalize the novel robustness property for EE networks, prove it is Fixed-Parameter Tractable under a trace stability condition

translated_title: 帕累托DNN验证：对大多数查询快速完成
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络（DNN）的形式化验证面临一个根本性的可扩展性挑战：验证鲁棒性是NP难的，且最先进的工具在现代架构上经常超时。我们提出了帕累托验证方法（Pareto VErification，简称PAVE）：通过为DNN添加早期退出机制并逐个退出点进行验证，我们在直接验证所需时间的一小部分内解决了大部分鲁棒性查询，在我们的评估中约为80%。关键洞察在于，鲁棒性邻域中的许多输入会在较早的层就退出。验证这种早期退出行为通常是一个可处理的问题，使得验证可以在完整网络被分析之前很久就终止。早期退出机制可以在不修改基础网络的情况下添加，并且在我们测试的所有架构上最多只带来0.3%的准确率变化。我们为早期退出网络形式化了新颖的鲁棒性属性，并证明在轨迹稳定性条件下该问题是固定参数可解的。
tldr: 提出PAVE方法，通过为DNN添加早期退出机制并逐退出点验证，能以直接验证所需时间的一小部分解决约80%的鲁棒性查询，且准确率变化不超过0.3%。
en_tdlr: PAVE augments DNNs with early exits and verifies exit-by-exit, solving roughly 80% of robustness queries in a small fraction of the time required for direct verification, with at most 0.3% accuracy change.
